summary: The registrant filed an 8-K to disclose a third amendment to a fee letter under a master repurchase agreement. The amendment increased the facility amount from $500M to $750M between AB CRE PDF Lending C LLC (seller), the registrant (guarantor), and Citibank (buyer). No price per share, premium, or deal close is stated because this is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation. The filing is a standard current report on a material definitive agreement and direct financial obligation. There are no activist, tender, spin-off, or restructuring elements. The event is an ordinary financing arrangement adjustment with no special-situations characteristics.
